decisions.assessment: Sign wording prohibits parking; not a generic no-stopping equivalence. Original quotation is a parking sign.
Service counter for tax refunds, not a guaranteed refund entitlement; original airport context fits.
Notice for exceeding a speed limit; no fine amount, deadline or jurisdiction procedure claimed.
Place of changing currencies, not a foreign-exchange rate; across-from relationship preserved.
Travel personal-care bag, not a washcloth or equipment box; toothbrushing/shampoo nouns fit.
Hand-held electrified racket for flying insects, not a stationary attraction lamp. Folding-handle example fits.
Entry authorisation ticket in the named visitor contexts, not a claim of unlimited or free access.
Requested normal-view/mirror qualifier accepted: not claiming that no shoulder/head turn could reveal any hidden area.
Sole designed to reduce slipping, not a guarantee of never slipping or a whole-shoe safety certification.
Road and rail same-level crossing; UK term not an overpass. Original bend is beyond it.
Natural shoes-as-subject expression for friction discomfort; no presumption of an injury or blister.
Selected room-heating appliance noun, not a car cooling radiator or electronics heatsink.
Dry-cleaning service/payment document, not a care label. Original coat-pocket example agrees.
Booked haircut service time; Saturday ten in morning is preserved in Chinese.
Selected recipient-ready-to-collect context explicit. Does not equate every generic collection notice with readiness; no courier-pickup-completed claim.
General small repairs/maintenance person with no gender restriction or professional licence guarantee.
Zero/trace-sugar selected product; not just no-added-sugar yoghurt. No zero-calorie or medical diet guarantee.
Travel import tax/duty limit concept, quantity/value, not an exemption promise or a numeric legal threshold.

scope: Selected common lexical senses and original EN/ZH checked individually; no legal, medical or product safety guidance.
